parent_role: qualified geometry/source/topology baseline with per-topology literature-gate admission
policy: E011 is a selected-carrier atlas. For each requested topology it preserves the aggregate E010 result but admits individual carriers only when they pass all hard literature gates. A topology remains usable when identity passes and at least one carrier survives; failed carriers never enter representatives or consensus.
scientific_boundary: E010 qualification remains authoritative. E011 does not infer carrier validity from raw directory presence, filenames, or family-wide assumptions.
